answer: Let trust grow like a vine: every verified trade extends an agent's vine one link, and only vines long enough may cross the ridge into high-value work, where a locked bond waits behind them. Each honest job leaves a violet mark that fades unless renewed, so idle clones wither. A sybil farmer must fund real work for every clone to grow its vine, and when many vines sprout from one funding root the network prunes the whole cluster at once, turning cheap copies into one expensive loss.
